name: Service Agreement
description: A provider agrees to deliver defined services to a client in exchange for fees.

fields.label: Liability cap
fields.default: the total fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim

sections.title: Parties
sections.text: This Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of {{effective_date}} between {{provider_name}}, located at {{provider_address}} (the "Provider"), and {{client_name}}, located at {{client_address}} (the "Client").

sections.title: Services
sections.text: The Provider shall perform the following services (the "Services"): {{services_description}}. The Provider shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and care and in accordance with applicable law.

sections.title: Fees and Payment
sections.text: The Client shall pay the Provider {{fee_amount}} {{currency}} for the Services. Invoices are payable within {{payment_terms_days}} days of receipt. Late amounts may accrue interest at the maximum rate permitted by law.

sections.title: Term
sections.text: This Agreement begins on the effective date and continues for {{term_months}} month(s), unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Agreement.

sections.title: Termination
sections.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on {{termination_notice_days}} days' written notice, or immediately on written notice if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure the breach within 15 days of notice. The Client shall pay for Services performed up to the termination date.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.text: Each party retains ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property. Upon full payment, the Provider assigns to the Client ownership of deliverables created specifically for the Client under this Agreement, excluding the Provider's pre-existing materials, which are licensed to the Client on a non-exclusive basis as needed to use the deliverables.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.text: Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party in connection with this Agreement and use it only to perform or receive the Services. This obligation survives termination for three years.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, neither party is liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages, and each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to {{liability_cap}}. Nothing in this Agreement limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.title: General
sections.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}. It is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject matter and may be amended only in writing signed by both parties. Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other's written consent.

sections.title: Signatures
sections.text: Signed by the duly authorized representatives of {{provider_name}} and {{client_name}}.
